title: Run record
description: One run timeline row. Trigger provenance records why and by whom the run started independently from CLI session resume mechanics.

intent.description: Legacy CLI session action such as start, continue, recovery, restart, or reissue. It is not the business trigger.

startedAt.description: UTC instant at which execution started.

trigger.description: Closed business-trigger vocabulary. Null only for legacy rows, which UIs display as not recorded.

triggeredBy.description: Actor: operator client/user, pipeline, runner <id>, or watchdog.

triggerReason.description: One sentence explaining why this run started.

triggerSource.description: Review attempt/aspect ids, integration failure code, or at most the first 300 prompt characters.
